title: FlowRec: Prior-Informed Flow Matching for Efficient Sequential Recommendation Generation
abstract: arXiv:2508.17618v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Sequential recommendation aims to predict each user's next preferred item based on their historical interactions. Recently, diffusion-based approaches have demonstrated strong generative capability in modeling complex user preferences. However, they still face two inherent limitations: (i) Gaussian priors are misaligned with user-specific interests, and curved noise schedules lead to error accumulation and unstable training; (ii) the stochastic denoising process introduces additional randomness and substantial computational overhead. To address these issues, we propose FlowRec, a flow-matching-based framework that formulates preference evolution as continuous flows between personalized priors and target items. translated_title: FlowRec：先验信息的流匹配实现高效序列推荐生成
translated_abstract: 序列推荐旨在根据用户的历史交互预测其下一个偏好的物品。近年来，基于扩散的方法在建模复杂用户偏好方面展现了强大的生成能力。然而，它们仍面临两个固有的局限性：（i）高斯先验与用户特定兴趣不一致，且弯曲的噪声调度会导致误差累积和训练不稳定；（ii）随机去噪过程引入了额外的随机性和大量的计算开销。为解决这些问题，我们提出了FlowRec，一个基于流匹配的框架，将偏好演化表述为个性化先验与目标物品之间的连续流。具体而言，FlowRec基于用户历史交互构建了一个信息丰富的行为先验分布，为目标分布提供了分布上更接近的初始化。随后，它学习一个向量场（原文摘要此处被截断）。
tldr: FlowRec提出了一种基于流匹配的序列推荐框架，通过从用户历史交互中构建行为先验分布，并将偏好演化建模为个性化先验与目标物品之间的连续流，从而解决了扩散模型中高斯先验与用户兴趣错位以及随机去噪带来的计算开销问题。
en_tdlr: FlowRec is a flow-matching-based sequential recommendation framework that constructs behavior-informed prior distributions from user histories and models preference evolution as continuous flows between personalized priors and target items, addressing the misalignment of Gaussian priors and the computational overhead of stochastic denoising in diffusion-based approaches.
